args.title: Add BOM to CSV exports to ensure UTF-8 detection
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Include a BOM in CSV exports to allow spreadsheet applications to automatically detect UTF-8 encoding, as provided by default in CsvOptions.

label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

CSV exports in src/export/csv.ts include a BOM by design, as set by default in CsvOptions. This allows spreadsheet apps to detect UTF-8 encoding.
